title: Autonomous Maintenance Platform — Containers (C2) · TO-BE target, org-wide

nodes.name: Control Plane
nodes.desc: Per-task state machines; fair share across products × token availability; rails at burst/task/product/subscription/org level; webhook wake-up, poll for truth

nodes.name: Burst Runners
nodes.tech: [k8s Jobs · microVM runtime (Kata / e2b — DR) · dev / reviewer / tester]
nodes.desc: One Job per burst; warm image per product family; no k8s API, egress allowlist; session materialized before boot, harvested after

nodes.name: Webhook Receiver
nodes.tech: [stateless · behind ingress · the ONLY public surface]
nodes.desc: Verifies HMAC per App secret, dedups by delivery id, emits wake events — holds no other credential; forgery ≤ one extra poll

nodes.name: Console + CLI
nodes.desc: LIVE fleet state + streaming burst logs (SSE/WS); task timelines, usage per subscription, violations feed, memory browser; audited operator actions

nodes.name: Monitor
nodes.desc: Files structured auto issues from telemetry (integration-breakage detectors first); rate-limited, behind the ready gate

nodes.name: Ledger
nodes.desc: tasks · bursts · violations + products, quotas, subscriptions, audit log — same protocol as the MVP's SQLite

nodes.name: Session Archive
nodes.desc: Task-keyed resumable transcripts, checksummed; retention policy applies here

nodes.name: Platform Memory
nodes.desc: Product + platform tiers; written only via harvest (agent proposes), read only via prompt assembly as auto-class data; gardener + human browser

nodes.name: Observability
nodes.desc: Trace-per-burst, task correlation; feeds the console's live streams and the standing dashboards; agents emit, never read

nodes.name: Product Teams
nodes.desc: Own both gates in GitHub: ready label + review & merge; watch their products live in the console; contribute subscriptions to the pool

nodes.name: Platform Team
nodes.desc: Registers products, sets quotas, manages the pool, handles incidents — through the console, never SQL

nodes.name: GitHub (Fermata org)
nodes.tech: [4 org Apps: dev · reviewer · tester · monitor]
nodes.desc: Issues, PRs, reviews, branch protection, CI — per-repo-scoped tokens minted per burst

nodes.name: Product Repos ×N
nodes.desc: Each carries its contracts: CLAUDE.md + TESTING.md (socket and plug)

nodes.name: Product Sandboxes
nodes.desc: TEST_* creds from the secret manager, injected into tester bursts only

nodes.name: Claude (Anthropic)
nodes.desc: Opt-in member tokens with usage caps; rate-limit-aware rotation; every burst attributed to its subscription

nodes.name: Secret Manager
nodes.desc: Platform creds + registered subscription tokens + per-product TEST_* sets; injected at spawn, never archived

nodes.name: Slack
nodes.desc: Ball-is-with-you nudges + budget/violation alerts; deep links only, never actionable

nodes.name: Org Telemetry
nodes.desc: Existing signals from running products; the monitor's input

edges.label: Live view of their products; pool opt-in + caps
Operator API + live event stream [SSO, audit]
Recall at spawn (scope-filtered) · store proposals at harvest
Polls for truth; posts reviews + reports; mints per-repo tokens
App webhook events (HMAC-signed) — zero per-repo config
Spawns Jobs: prompt + role envelope + memory context + rails
Fetch creds + pool token at spawn
Dev role only: clone, push, PR [scoped App token]
Agent loop [pooled token; mechanism B keeps it on the member's device]
Tester role: boots product, drives E2E
